stemMd: What situation falsifies "If the server is online, the dashboard is available"?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The server is online and the dashboard is available.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The server is offline and the dashboard is unavailable.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The server is offline and the dashboard is available.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The dashboard is available regardless of server status.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The server is online and the dashboard is unavailable.

explanationMd: An implication is false exactly when its antecedent is true and its consequent is false: online server together with unavailable dashboard.

distractorRationale.d: That would never violate the stated requirement.
distractorRationale.b: An absent antecedent does not falsify the implication.
distractorRationale.c: The rule imposes no condition when the server is offline.
